items.title: The degree function attached to a dualizing complex is a dimension function
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement says that the degree function defined by a dualizing complex on a Noetherian ring is a dimension function, i.e. that it drops by exactly one along an immediate specialization (author lemma at source lines 3497-3503, label lemma-dimension-function). The proof (source lines 3505-3538) first reduces to a domain with the smaller prime equal to zero and the larger prime of height one, then identifies the unique nonvanishing degree of the localization at the generic point with the negative value of the function there, and compares it with the normalized description at the larger prime, where the only nonzero degree over the fraction field is minus the dimension, which is minus one (proof lines 3524-3537). The comparison of the two normalizations is the substance. H3.
